Packaging decades-old judicial execution into a fast-food freak show diminishes the gravity of taking a human life for public entertainment.

The reporting uses a Smart Selfish maneuver, manufacturing moral outrage through grotesque trivia (last meal requests) to monetize human tragedy, projecting pure monstrosity while ignoring deeper systemic questions around capital punishment.

The Trajectory: The Path of Reckoning.
When you map the gap between sober justice and tabloid sensationalism, it plots a direct trajectory toward Destruction. Exploitative framing accelerates systemic decay by reducing capital punishment to a spectator sport.
